edges.fact: Disneyland hosts Halloween Time, starting mid-September with festive decorations, themed food, and special entertainment.
Halloween Time at Disneyland includes the Halloween-themed parade and the Oogie Boogie Bash as highlights.
Knott's Berry Farm hosts Knott's Scary Farm, a Halloween event running through the fall featuring haunted mazes, scare zones, and live entertainment.
Six Flags Magic Mountain hosts Fright Fest, its annual Halloween event with haunted mazes, scare zones, and themed rides from late September to early November.
Six Flags Magic Mountain hosts Holiday in the Park, beginning in late November with holiday lights, festive entertainment, and special seasonal attractions.
Universal Studios Hollywood hosts Halloween Horror Nights, running mid-September to early November with elaborate haunted houses, scare zones, and thrilling rides.
Universal Studios Hollywood hosts Grinchmas, starting late November with festive decorations, live shows, and themed food.
Halloween Time at Disneyland features Pumpkin Beignets, a seasonal beignet drizzled with orange glaze and topped with pumpkin spice.
Halloween Time at Disneyland features Mummy Dogs, hot dogs wrapped in flaky pastry served with graveyard dirt (chocolate pudding with crushed Oreos and gummy worms).
Halloween Time at Disneyland features Bat Wing Chicken Tenders, chicken strips shaped like bat wings served with spicy BBQ 'blood' sauce.
Halloween Time at Disneyland features Candy Corn Funnel Cake, topped with candy corn, powdered sugar, and whipped cream.
Knott's Scary Farm features Graveyard Dirt Cups, chocolate pudding parfaits with crushed Oreos, gummy worms, and edible dirt.
Knott's Scary Farm features Mummy Meatball Subs, meatballs wrapped in flaky pastry served on a toasted sub roll with marinara sauce.
Knott's Scary Farm features Skeleton Fingers Cookies, crunchy sugar cookies shaped like skeleton fingers.
Knott's Scary Farm features Blood-Red Punch, a fruity drink with a hint of grenadine served in a souvenir cup with a glow stick.
Halloween Horror Nights features Flesh-Eating Zombie Fingers, crispy fried chicken strips coated in spicy buffalo sauce served with blue cheese dressing.
Halloween Horror Nights features Graveyard Cake Pops, bite-sized cake pops dipped in white chocolate and decorated with edible flowers and skulls.
Halloween Horror Nights features Blood of the Vine, a sweet and fruity drink with a hint of cranberry served in a souvenir cup with a glow stick.
Fright Fest features Zombie Brain Cupcakes, rich chocolate cupcakes filled with raspberry jelly 'brain' centers, topped with cream cheese frosting and edible sugar decorations.
Fright Fest features Mummy Dogs, hot dogs wrapped in flaky pastry served with 'tombstone' spicy mustard sauce.
Fright Fest features Skeleton Keys Lime Bars, tart lime bars with a shortbread crust topped with edible gold dust.
Fright Fest features Witch's Brew, a sweet and fruity drink with a hint of lemon-lime served in a souvenir cup with a glow stick.
Blue Bayou Restaurant is a restaurant at Disneyland offering a special Halloween-themed menu during Halloween Time.
Carthay Circle Restaurant is a restaurant at Disneyland offering a special five-course Halloween tasting menu during Halloween Time.
PCH Grill is a buffet-style restaurant at Disney's Paradise Pier Hotel that hosts Halloween Character Dining with Disney characters in Halloween costumes.
The Calico Saloon is an Old West-themed saloon at Knott's Berry Farm offering a special Halloween menu, including Bat Wing Chicken Tenders and a signature Witch's Brew cocktail.
The Calico Saloon at Knott's Scary Farm offers Witch's Brew as a signature Halloween cocktail.
The Terror Tipsy Turvey Lounge is an exclusive lounge experience at Halloween Horror Nights offering signature cocktails and small plates while mingling with scareactors.
The Full Throttle Sports Bar at Six Flags Magic Mountain offers a special Halloween menu, including Zombie Brain Cupcakes and a signature Witch's Brew cocktail.
Knott's Berry Farm offers The Knott's Scary Farm Boo-fet, a buffet-style dining experience with priority entry and a souvenir photo.
Six Flags Magic Mountain offers The Fright Fest Feast, a buffet-style dining experience with priority entry and a souvenir photo.

Universal Studios Hollywood offers the VIP Experience's Gourmet Buffet at Halloween Horror Nights, priced around $250 to over $400 per person with perks like priority entry, front-of-line access, an exclusive VIP lounge, a private tour guide, a commemorative photo, and a special VIP gift.

The Behind-the-Scenes Tour is an available add-on to the VIP Experience's Gourmet Buffet at Halloween Horror Nights, a 1-hour tour of the makeup and special effects department, maze design, scare zone design, costume and prop design, and backstage areas.
Carthay Circle Restaurant's Halloween Feast tasting menu features dishes inspired by Disney's Halloween classic The Nightmare Before Christmas.
Carthay Circle Restaurant's Halloween Feast tasting menu features dishes inspired by Disney's Halloween classic Hocus Pocus.
